framework: Next.js 16.3.8 (App Router) with React 19.3.0, Chakra UI 3.37, TypeScript
rendering: Statically prerendered at build time (SSG). All marketing routes appear in build/prerender-manifest.json and production responses carry x-nextjs-prerender: 1 with x-nextjs-cache: HIT. Served by nginx/1.24.0 (Ubuntu) in front of next start (cache-control: s-maxage=31536000).
metadataLocation: Root defaults in src/app/metadata.ts (consumed by src/app/layout.tsx) with title.template "%s | TIS Risk Managers", metadataBase from pageInfo.url and alternates.canonical "/". Per-route metadata is exported from each route layout.tsx via src/lib/seo/buildPageMetadata.ts using the strings in src/lib/seo/pageMeta.ts. robots.txt from src/app/robots.ts, sitemap.xml from src/app/sitemap.ts (URL list from NAVIGATION_ROUTES in src/constants/app.ts, base URL from APP_CONFIG.url). JSON-LD is injected by src/components/seo/JsonLd.tsx using src/lib/seo/organizationSchema.ts, breadcrumbs.ts and pageFaqs.ts.

capture.method: node fetch with redirect: "manual", following Location headers one hop at a time; HTML parsed with jsdom (scripts not executed, so values reflect the server-rendered HTML).
capture.visibleBodyHash: sha256 over document.body.textContent after removing script/style/noscript/template and collapsing all whitespace runs to single spaces.
capture.visibleBodyHashMethod: sha256 of body HTML with script/style/noscript/template removed, tags stripped, whitespace collapsed (seo-check.mjs)

robotsTxt.notes: Also served on https://www.tisrm.nl/robots.txt with the same content, pointing at the non-www sitemap.

routesNotInSitemap.title: Offerte aanvragen | TIS Risk Managers
routesNotInSitemap.notes: Indexable (robots: index, follow) but absent from the sitemap. 307 is a temporary redirect.

routesNotInSitemap.title: Offerte aanvragen | TIS Risk Managers
routesNotInSitemap.notes: Canonical points at /offerte, which itself 307-redirects back to /offerte/stap-1, so the canonical target is a redirect.
Permanent redirect configured twice: next.config.mjs redirects() and permanentRedirect('/downloads') in src/app/bestanden/page.tsx. Behaves as expected; not in sitemap (correct).

routesNotInSitemap.title: Offerte aanvragen | TIS Risk Managers
routesNotInSitemap.notes: Identical title, description and canonical to stap-1 and stap-3; all three inherit the /offerte layout metadata.

routesNotInSitemap.title: Offerte aanvragen | TIS Risk Managers
routesNotInSitemap.notes: Identical title, description and canonical to stap-1 and stap-2; all three inherit the /offerte layout metadata.

hostingAndHeaders.notes: nginx-config-example.conf in the repo declares `return 301 https://tisrm.nl$request_uri` for www.tisrm.nl (lines 5-12) and for apex http (lines 17-25). Production does not behave that way: http redirects are 302 and https://www.tisrm.nl answers 200 with no redirect at all. The deployed nginx therefore differs from the committed example, or the www vhost is not served by it.
hostingAndHeaders.extraServerNamesProbe: https://mail.tisrm.nl/ does not accept connections (curl exit: could not connect), so it is not a live duplicate-content host despite appearing in the example config's server_name list.

baseUrlConfiguration.siteUrl: https://tisrm.nl hardcoded in APP_CONFIG.url (src/constants/app.ts) and used by sitemap.ts, robots.ts and metadataBase; not environment-driven.
baseUrlConfiguration.notes: NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL is defined in .env.local but not referenced anywhere in application code. NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is referenced in src/lib/utils.ts but is not in .env.local. No search-console verification tokens are set in metadata.

llmsTxtContradiction.reality: All of /offerte, /offerte/stap-1, /offerte/stap-2 and /offerte/stap-3 serve `robots: index, follow` in production. No noIndex is set in src/lib/seo/pageMeta.ts for the quote flow.

notFoundBehaviour.notes: Returns a correct 404 status, but emits two conflicting robots metas, canonicals to the homepage, reuses the homepage title, and the H1 is in English on an nl site.
